newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Securum says sells UK properties for 73 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Securum says sells UK properties for 73 mln stg.

text.p: Securum, the company formed to manage Swedish commercial bank Nordbanken's bad debts and property, said on Wednesday it had sold three British properties for a total of 73 million sterling.
Securum said in a statement it sold two UK hotels to Alliance Hospitality UK for over 50 million sterling and Kew Retail Park to Sun Life for 23 million sterling.

"The two hotels, the Holiday Inn, Victoria, London and the Holiday Inn Crowne Plaza on the Royal Mile, Edinburgh, which combined have 450 rooms, were acquired in early 1993 by Securum Hotel Holdings Ltd as part of the plan to reconstruct Nordbanken ."
The 135,000-square-foot Kew Retail Park in South West London was also acquired by Securum in 1993, the company said.
